notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
Major changes in Version 1.03
- The type of character can now be specifically set in the forces settings of the Skirmish mode
- Increased the maximum number of forces in Skirmish mode to 12

notes.title: Version 1.02
notes.content:
Major changes in Version 1.02
- Fixed an issue where the number of enemies killed with guns would sometimes be counted lower than the actual number
- Increased the maximum number of forces in Skirmish mode to 10

notes.title: Version 1.01
notes.content:
Major changes in Version 1.01
- Added supported languages (Russian, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish)
  * Additional supported languages were determined based on volunteer translators and store page access statistics.
- Some modifications for multilingual support
- Added hints to some messages in the episode
- Slightly reduced the difficulty level
- Adjusted some episodes
- Added hidden features
* Updates may change the placement results of saved Skirmish settings.
